events.title: Switch casters from rubber to polyurethane
events.description: Floor test on customer concrete showed rubber casters marking and squealing; Priya decided to switch to 75mm PU casters and asked Leo to change the order. Sam approved and asked for it to be logged.

events.title: LiDAR (LX-270) lead time slips from 4 to 14 weeks
events.description: Sentrix acknowledged the PO with a 14-week lead time due to an upstream laser diode issue; no eval stock, possible partial of 4 units at ~6 weeks. Threatens DVT unit count and triggers second-source evaluation of Rangewell RL-2, which affects the nose FOV cutout post-freeze.

events.title: Motor driver board FETs exceed thermal spec; late heatsink/standoff change into freeze
events.description: Ramp soak with mc-fw 0.9.3 drove MDB FETs to 104C (spec 85C); dropping PWM to 20kHz gave 93C, still over. Resolution requires an 8mm standoff and larger heatsink, forcing a harness reroute and tub rev F just before mechanical freeze.

events.title: E-stop latency measured at 118ms avg / 160ms worst vs 50ms requirement
events.description: Bench measurement showed e-stop routed through the main loop on a rev A MDB. Sam required a rev B measurement before DVT. Resolved on day 8: rev B STO path measured 22ms avg / 31ms worst.

events.title: Customer rack beam lip question blocks scissor lift stroke confirmation
events.description: Priya asked whether Brightline's rack beams have a ~40mm front lip, which would prevent tote clearance on the top shelf. No reply before freeze; re-asked on day 10 and still unanswered. Customer-facing requirement owned by the PM; could force an ECO.

events.title: Mechanical design freeze for DVT completed
events.description: Freeze package released (tub rev F, scissor rev D, nose rev C, DWM rev E) and drawings sent to Kessler. All further mechanical changes require ECOs. Electrical freeze target set to 10/17.

events.title: Firmware engineer out of office 10/20-10/24
events.description: Dani mentioned in an off-topic pizza thread in #general that she will be away 10/20-10/24, the week before the planned DVT build and during the electrical freeze run-up, with LiDAR driver and BMS firmware work pending. Only firmware owner on the team.

events.title: Cell vendor silently derates continuous discharge from 35A to 30A
events.description: Hanwa sent a datasheet rev described as 'editorial' that lowers the 21700 continuous discharge rating; peak per-string draw is ~32A. Confirmed real on day 8 and applies to the DVT lot. Stopgap BMS firmware clamp; possible 4p pack that is 18mm longer would need a post-freeze ECO.

events.title: Chassis weldment FAI failure: 3 of 5 tubs have out-of-tolerance pivot bores
events.description: Lift pivot bores off by 0.4-0.6mm vs +/-0.15mm tolerance due to a new Kessler fixture. Remake of 3 units with fixture fix, delivery ~10/23, close to the original 10/27 DVT start.

events.title: DVT build slips from 10/27 to 11/10; pilot moves to early December
events.description: Sam moved the DVT build start and electrical freeze (to 10/31) due to LiDAR supply, tub remakes, and the cell derating. Customer pilot with Brightline shifts from mid November to early December; PM to handle customer messaging.
